heading: From nine thousand names
to forty.
intro: Every equity portfolio is distilled through a five-stage process — quantitative, fundamental, and continuous — that narrows a global universe to the few dozen companies we choose to own.

stages.name: Universe of Equity Securities
stages.desc: We begin with the full global universe of publicly traded equities.

stages.name: Quantitative Analysis
stages.desc: Proprietary screens filter for structural constraints, growth and value characteristics, and a multi-factor ranking.

stages.name: Fundamental Analysis
stages.desc: The investment committee validates earnings growth and sustainability — business and peer analysis, SWOT, cash flow, and management quality.

stages.name: Portfolio Construction
stages.desc: We build a diversified portfolio of 40–60 holdings, subject to country, sector, industry, and position-size risk controls.

stages.name: Sell Discipline
stages.desc: Active risk management runs continuously — quantitative, technical, and qualitative triggers govern when we trim or exit.
